items.title: Handcuffs count in the War Room model (your rule 14)
items.changed: Each week now counts a small chance (12%, Claude's estimate) that a starting RB misses the game, and that his backup from the same NFL team fills in. Braelon Allen is worth about 15 pts a week if Breece Hall sits (his real average in the 5 weeks Hall missed).
items.why: The model gave Allen zero value while Hall was healthy, so it kept telling you to drop him (Kirk Cousins for Allen). You said Allen is why you survived.
items.notice: No suggestion drops Allen now. Today's top free add is Ladd McConkey for Tre Tucker; the QB adds drop Woody Marks instead. Your odds barely move (win 7%, cut risk 8%).
